meta.title: API Peak/Off-Peak Reminder
meta.description: Shows DeepSeek API peak/off-peak pricing and the account balance as a centered Dynamic Island: a small dot with a progress ring when idle, expanding to full details on hover or click. Off-peak is green, peak is red, and the final hour turns yellow and blinks.

peak-title: Heads up! It's Liang Wenfeng time!
tooltip: DeepSeek API peak hours: Mon–Fri 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing time, excluding Chinese statutory holidays. All other times are off-peak (50% price).
